context: Retired Hiroshi-boss visits the family home; Hina and Sho gather to meet "uncle".

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 田中おじさん！いらっしゃい！
lines.style: Bright, unguarded joy. Immediate and genuine — no filter between thought and voice. Warm, open, the kind of happiness a child shows without performance. Natural rise on the greeting, then settles into welcome.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ひなちゃん、しょうくん、お元気で。
lines.en: Hina-chan, Sho-kun — you both look well.
lines.style: Warm authority held lightly. Genuine pleasure beneath the composed surface. Measured cadence, but the affection comes through in the softness around the edges. A man pleased to see them, saying it plainly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Soft, careful greeting. A moment's hesitation before the words — the quiet politeness of a younger child being respectful. Small voice, genuine warmth underneath the formality. A shy smile in the sound.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 二人で、ずっと、おじさん、覚えててくれて、嬉しい。
lines.en: I'm so glad you both remembered your uncle all this time.
lines.style: Quiet, touched sincerity. The words come slower, weighted with genuine feeling. A catch in the voice — the kind of tenderness that catches a man by surprise. Soft close, like he's moved.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: おじさん、また、ありがとう！
lines.en: Uncle, thank you for coming again!
lines.style: Bright, full-bodied gratitude. Immediate and eager. The natural exuberance of a child saying something true and uncomplicated. Warm throughout, with a small lift at the end — delight, not performance.
